[[File:Geonosian-Hasbro.png|thumb|right|250px|A Geonosian]]
'''Insectoid''' was a term that described a [[Species/Legends|species]] that had some characteristic of [[Insect/Legends|insects]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] were a famous example of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] insectoid species. While most insectoids possessed a [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]], a number of them existed with only a partial hive-consciousness or simply as individuals within the greater species.
